messages.text:
I’ve proposed a refund of **BRL 142.80** for the bedsheet set and pillowcases, which are recorded as received back. The blanket hasn’t been recorded as received, so it can’t be included yet; it must arrive back first. (refund-policy/v2/return)

Please confirm the proposal using the button on its card. A “yes” in chat won’t confirm it.
The customer confirmed request prop-9f3913fcba6943b0 and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.

The refund of **BRL 142.80** has been recorded. Your receipt number is **R-00000001**. In this demonstration, the receipt records the refund in the shop’s test ledger; it is not a bank transfer, and the shop gives no date for money to appear on a card. (refund-policy/v2/payout)
That’s what I wanted for the items you’ve received back. I’ll send the blanket later.

Thanks for confirming. The refund for the received items is recorded under receipt **R-00000001**. The blanket must arrive back and be recorded as received before it can be requested for a refund. (refund-policy/v2/return)
